data.title: 爱西亚 · 喷泉广场的白鸽与祈愿
data.description: 欧式风情的公园喷泉广场前水花飞溅，白鸽围绕着爱西亚翩翩起舞。少女双手合十贴在胸前，转头对你绽放出无瑕的纯真微笑，宛如从油画中走出的圣洁少女。
data.location: scenic European style park fountain plaza
data.action: standing by stone fountain scattering breadcrumbs to white doves, turning to partner with hands clasped in prayer, smiling with pure angelic joy
data.lighting: bright golden morning sunlight glistening on fountain spray
data.mood: pure idyllic serenity, storybook romance, blissful holiday date
data.promptProse: Standing by a sparkling park fountain with white doves fluttering around, Asia clasps hands with an angelic smile under morning sunshine.
data.animaCaption: Asia Argento smiling angelic with doves at a sparkling park fountain.
